# Motherlode

**The mother of all design libraries.**

Every kind of design, for everything, in one place: 50 sections and 867 categories, from logos and landing pages to dashboards, Mac menu bar apps, album covers, worksheets and tattoo designs. 56 designs so far, each in several colorways. Make something once, drop it here, and nobody has to make it again.

## How it's organized

- Designs are sorted by what they are, not the tool they were made in. A landing page goes in `web/landing-pages/` whether it was made in Figma, Framer or code.
- If something fits more than one category, put it where people would look first.
- Missing a category? Add it to [`.github/scripts/build_catalog.py`](.github/scripts/build_catalog.py) and run `python3 .github/scripts/build_catalog.py`. It rebuilds every folder and table.

## Adding a design

Every design gets its own folder inside a category, named in lowercase with dashes:

```text
social/
└── linkedin-posts/
    └── launch-announcement/
        ├── README.md     what it is, where it's used, which fonts and colors it needs
        ├── preview.png   what people see when they browse
        ├── source/       the editable file (.fig, .psd, .ai, .aep, .html …)
        └── exports/      ready-to-use files (.png, .svg, .mp4, .pdf …)
```

`preview.png` matters most. It's how people find the right design without opening every file.

## Big files

GitHub warns about files over 50 MB and rejects anything over 100 MB. For heavy sources like raw video or huge PSDs, use [Git LFS](https://git-lfs.com) or keep the file in shared storage and link to it from the design's README.
